title: Luke 13:31-35
subtitle: Thursday of the 30th Week in Ordinary Time · Eph 6:10-20; Lk 13:31-35
text: Warned that Herod wants to kill him, Jesus keeps walking toward Jerusalem on his own timetable. Then he laments over the city: "How many times I yearned to gather your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, but you were unwilling!" His love is not frightened off, and it does not force itself on anyone.
imageAlt: Jesus seated on a hilltop with his disciples, looking out over the city of Jerusalem at sunset and weeping.
